mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.master_venue (id, name, address, city, location_lat, location_lng, metadata, confidence, source) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{address}, #{city}, #{locationLat}, #{locationLng}, #{metadata, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.iqkv.docintelligence.catalogprocessingworker.infrastructure.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, #{confidence}, #{source})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.master_venue SET name = #{name}, address = #{address}, city = #{city}, location_lat = #{locationLat}, location_lng = #{locationLng}, metadata = #{metadata, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.iqkv.docintelligence.catalogprocessingworker.infrastructure.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, confidence = #{confidence}, source = #{source}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, address, city, location_lat, location_lng, metadata, confidence, source, created_at, updated_at FROM public.master_venue WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, address, city, location_lat, location_lng, metadata, confidence, source, created_at, updated_at FROM public.master_venue ORDER BY name LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, name, address, city, location_lat, location_lng, metadata, confidence, source, created_at, updated_at FROM public.master_venue WHERE LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{name}) ORDER BY name
